assess_differential_and_association.body: Recorded inputs: severity {ParkinsonismSeverity_state} ({ParkinsonismSeverity_source}); attribution {AttributionContext_state} ({AttributionContext_source}); dose-reduction feasible {DoseReductionFeasible_state} ({DoseReductionFeasible_source}); switch feasible {SwitchFeasible_state} ({SwitchFeasible_source}); psychosis tradeoff {PsychosisTradeoffConcern_state} ({PsychosisTradeoffConcern_source}); preference concern {MedicationPreferenceConcern_state} ({MedicationPreferenceConcern_source}); anticholinergic safety {AnticholinergicSafetyConcern_state} ({AnticholinergicSafetyConcern_source}); older-age vulnerability {OlderAgeVulnerability_state} ({OlderAgeVulnerability_source}); other burden {OtherAnticholinergicBurden_state} ({OtherAnticholinergicBurden_source}); current anticholinergic use {CurrentAnticholinergicUse_state} ({CurrentAnticholinergicUse_source}); prior significant parkinsonism {PriorSignificantParkinsonism_state} ({PriorSignificantParkinsonism_source}); amantadine safety {AmantadineSafetyConcern_state} ({AmantadineSafetyConcern_source}); TD concern {TardiveDyskinesiaConcern_state} ({TardiveDyskinesiaConcern_source}). Network Parkinsonism_F3_draft ({network_version}) posteriors: indication established {p_established}%, assess-differential {p_assess}%, no-rule {p_norule}% (CPT percentages and posteriors are shown separately; posteriors are not diagnostic probabilities and not treatment-effect estimates). Review prompt: the movement attribution is recorded as alternative-or-unresolved or is still unknown/incomplete. Assess onset timing, medication-change linkage, and alternative explanations (Parkinson disease, other neurology, catatonia, negative symptoms, depressive slowing, unmasking with delayed-recovery reassessment; selected DAT imaging only for diagnostically uncertain cases) with examination and indicated history before any symptomatic-medication discussion. No symptomatic-medication prompt is made from this branch. Regimen: {regimen_text}. Safety: {safety_text}. Symptomatic: {symptomatic_text}. Continuation: {continuation_text}. Amantadine: {amantadine_text}. Prophylaxis: {prophylaxis_text}. {urgent_text} {unknown_disclosure}
assess_differential_and_association.heading: Parkinsonism review (F3): assess differential and association

established_current_association.body: Recorded inputs: severity {ParkinsonismSeverity_state} ({ParkinsonismSeverity_source}); attribution {AttributionContext_state} ({AttributionContext_source}); dose-reduction feasible {DoseReductionFeasible_state} ({DoseReductionFeasible_source}); switch feasible {SwitchFeasible_state} ({SwitchFeasible_source}); psychosis tradeoff {PsychosisTradeoffConcern_state} ({PsychosisTradeoffConcern_source}); preference concern {MedicationPreferenceConcern_state} ({MedicationPreferenceConcern_source}); anticholinergic safety {AnticholinergicSafetyConcern_state} ({AnticholinergicSafetyConcern_source}); older-age vulnerability {OlderAgeVulnerability_state} ({OlderAgeVulnerability_source}); other burden {OtherAnticholinergicBurden_state} ({OtherAnticholinergicBurden_source}); current anticholinergic use {CurrentAnticholinergicUse_state} ({CurrentAnticholinergicUse_source}); prior significant parkinsonism {PriorSignificantParkinsonism_state} ({PriorSignificantParkinsonism_source}); amantadine safety {AmantadineSafetyConcern_state} ({AmantadineSafetyConcern_source}); TD concern {TardiveDyskinesiaConcern_state} ({TardiveDyskinesiaConcern_source}). Network Parkinsonism_F3_draft ({network_version}) posteriors: indication established {p_established}%, assess-differential {p_assess}%, no-rule {p_norule}%. Review prompt: parkinsonism associated with antipsychotic therapy is recorded; discuss options per current local labeling with the patient: feasible dose reduction, feasible switch to a lower-parkinsonism-propensity antipsychotic, or symptomatic medication, weighing reduced parkinsonism against psychotic worsening with careful monitoring. The physician decides treatment, product, and dose; this output never selects a drug or dose. Regimen: {regimen_text}. Safety: {safety_text}. Symptomatic: {symptomatic_text}. Continuation: {continuation_text}. Amantadine: {amantadine_text}. Prophylaxis: {prophylaxis_text}. {urgent_text} {unknown_disclosure}

not_applicable.body: No posterior is reported. The follow-up parkinsonism effect status is recorded as absent ({effect_source}), so this question does not apply. No inference, no CPTs, and no negative parkinsonism posterior are produced. An absent recording is never evidence about another movement disorder.
not_applicable.heading: Parkinsonism review (F3): not applicable

branches.unknown_disclosure: Inputs recorded as unknown/incomplete: {unknown_fields_or_none}. Unknown is not a negative finding; clarify as clinically indicated. SAS findings, where recorded, are measurement only and never establish severity bands, diagnosis, or intervention.

description: Predefined physician-review wording for parkinsonism F3. The LLM never supplies this text; the app renders the matching branch deterministically from stored posteriors, evidence, and missingness. All slots are escaped at render time. No branch diagnoses parkinsonism, selects a product, gives dosage, authorizes prophylaxis, or clears safety. Statement 12 is not appropriate for quality measurement or electronic decision support; these are research review prompts only.

conditions.text: URGENT recorded finding: severe generalized rigidity, fever, altered consciousness, or autonomic instability is recorded. Evaluate urgently for neuroleptic malignant syndrome per local emergency protocol rather than attributing to uncomplicated parkinsonism. Do not await model output.

deterministic_urgent_flag.otherwise: No deterministic urgent flag fires; the posterior branch above still requires physician review.
deterministic_urgent_flag.rule: Rendered directly from saved inputs WITHOUT waiting for any LLM request, inference result, or template posterior. Shown alongside (never replaced by) the posterior branch.

mapping_rule: Render the branch matching the highest-posterior IndicationReview state ONLY as a review prompt; the posterior maximum is not a validated recommendation rule and the physician may choose any course. Always render the stored RegimenReview, SafetyReview, SymptomaticMedicationReview, ContinuationReview, AmantadineReview, and ProphylaxisReview posteriors alongside. Always append unknown_disclosure. Always evaluate deterministic_urgent_flag from saved inputs first.
